traffic.loadError: Could not load MikroTik servers. Check you are logged in as a company manager and the API is reachable.
traffic.connectError: Could not open real-time connection. Check VPN/firewall and that the app URL matches your auth cookie domain.
traffic.noServers: No active MikroTik servers are linked to your network.
traffic.emptyInterfaces: No interfaces returned from the router.
traffic.statsLoadError: Could not load historical statistics for this server.
traffic.recPeakRxWarn: Receive peak is approaching warning range. Watch busy-hour congestion and rebalance sector load.
traffic.recPeakRxHigh: Receive peak is very high. Consider adding capacity or shifting traffic to an additional link/server.
traffic.recPeakTxWarn: Transmit peak is in warning range. Review heavy upload/backup activity in this period.
traffic.recPeakTxHigh: Transmit peak is very high. Investigate top upload sources and apply QoS controls if needed.
traffic.recLoadWarn: Load index is elevated. Prepare short-term capacity actions before demand spikes further.
traffic.recLoadHigh: Load index is critical. Immediate capacity expansion or traffic redistribution is recommended.
traffic.recHealthy: Indicators are currently within normal range. Continue routine monitoring.
